run_partimagenet_supercat_clip_name: run the partimagenet supercat CLIP name tool to generate text embeddings for supercat categories
run_partimagenet_supercat_clip_name_prom: run the partimagenet supercat CLIP name tool with custom prompt template for text encoding
run_partimagenet_supercat_clip_name_mode: run the partimagenet supercat CLIP name tool with a specific CLIP model variant
run_partimagenet_supercat_clip_name_outp: run the partimagenet supercat CLIP name tool and save text features to a specified output path
run_partimagenet_supercat_clip_name_cate: run the partimagenet supercat CLIP name tool to encode PartImageNet supercat category names into CLIP embeddings
